correctness.rationale: All geodesics have length at most three and the unique length-three geodesics join leaves on different clique hubs. This gives exactly one forbidden triple for each pair of selected leaves at distinct hubs. Unique active-hub partition and independent allowed core-edge selections prove the full polynomial. Saturation and one-edge-extension tests prove all facets. Comparing singleton/pair/triple active hub sizes proves nonpurity; monotonicity of the uniform facet-size formula proves the gap. BFS all-shortest-path enumeration of 55,360 edge subsets across six profiles independently corroborates both coefficient dictionaries and facets.

originality.rationale: The 2021 defining article and 2024 block-graph paper were inspected in accessible full text. The 2024 paper already proves the scalar one-pendant-per-hub optimum, which is explicitly excluded from novelty. Neither source contains the complete bivariate all-set enumerator, full facet classification for heterogeneous positive pendant multiplicities, or nonpurity and unbounded-gap spectrum. Closest indexed results concern vertex GP coronas, spider trees, or related distinct invariants. A 2026 corona-product paper remains inaccessible in full text and creates a documented but not decisive priority risk. Published-record and prior-statement comparisons found no directly covering implication; unindexed equivalence is possible.
residual_risks: The 2026 paper on edge GP corona products was not available in complete text; an implicit stronger enumeration result there could supersede part or all of the new claim.
An unindexed prior enumerator under geodesic-triple-free edge subsets or independence-polynomial terminology could exist.
No independent originality or proof audit has yet been performed.

value.rationale: The complete two-weight feasible-set enumerator and exact facet distribution solve a natural and previously scalar-focused edge-geodesic enumeration problem for an n-parameter family of block graphs. Facet number 2^n−1 is independent of all positive leaf multiplicities despite arbitrarily varying facet sizes. Nonpurity holds throughout and unit leaf multiplicity yields an unbounded interval of forbidden facet sizes, a structural boundary invisible to the previously known scalar optimum.
